g.text: everything fits on one screen (no scrolling)
A · Sequence overview (cell count over time)
one tiny chart per video sequence, grouped by cell line · bottom strip = avg movement of ALL cells
red circle = every cell jumps in the same frame → probably the microscope moved, not the cells
B · Track distributions by cell line
box plot + one dot per track · other metrics: duration, net displacement, straightness, # divisions
cell paths on the 1224 × 904 px image · tracks outside the brush fade to gray
show: ◉ full paths ○ last 10 frames ○ positions only
● start ○ division ✕ ends mid-image (apoptosis?) ↗ leaves image
wedge length = # of steps in that direction
time runs down · branch = mitosis · end mark = how the cell's track stops
